title: Threefold Reliquary
description: Corbelled white limestone ribs surround a levitating violet seed and its free-standing energy filaments.

review.notes: Round 3 (final). Fixed: painted light rectangles on the core are gone; one rib joint is now chipped; floor strands end in a small crystal cluster instead of a flat disc. Not fixed: (1) the core is still a coarse flat-shaded lozenge; the new horizontal wavy glare bands look like a stretched texture, not inner bands or a glow from within. (2) Filaments are still flat ribbon strips floating loosely beside the core, and one still crosses in front of it in hero.jpg (round-2 point 2). (3) The floor emitter is a tiny blob in the step hole, unreadable from the hero view; there is no socket or seat. (4) Rib blocks are still evenly jointed apart from the one chip.
